product.name: Monoprice Compact 3‑Port 65W GaN Charger For Laptop Tablets and Phones
product.description: Monoprice™Compact 3‑Port 65W GaN Charger: For Laptop, Tablets, and PhonesMulti‑Device Fast Charging from a Single Compact Charger Powered by GaN TechnologyThe Monoprice™ Compact 3‑Port 65W GaN Charger is an all‑in‑one powerhouse that charges multiple devices. With USB Power Delivery technology, the USB‑C® port supplies up to 65W that’s more than enough to fast charge popular full‑sized notebook computers (like the MacBook Pro®, MacBook Air®, Dell XPS™, and ThinkPad® laptops). Its Intelligent Power Distribution technology automatically allocates the optimal amount of power to each connected device and can charge up to 3 devices simultaneously, including phones, tablets, and laptops. GaN technology increases power efficiency while shrinking the circuit size, providing a compact architecture perfect for fitting into small spaces or taking with you on the go. The folding prong design is there for easy and travel‑friendly packing. Our chargers are tested and certified by independent ETL‑certified labs to ensure safe performance and protection from overheating, overcharging, excessive current, and short circuits.With up to 65W of charging power, it’s more than enough to fast charge even larger USB devices like laptops.Multi‑device charging: simultaneously charge up to 3 devices, including laptops, tablets, and phones.Intelligent Power Distribution: allocates the optimal amount of power to each charging device.Universal compatibility: regardless of brand or manufacturer, this charger is compatible with over 1,000 USB‑powered devices.Tested and certified via independent ETL‑certified laboratories to ensure safety. HIGH POWER, FAST CHARGINGSingle USB‑C port supplies up to 65W, enough for charging laptops but can also be used to charge tablets or phones as only proper amount of power will be drawn by device. ONE CHARGER, MORE DEVICESThree ports supply up to 45W/7.5W/7.5W for fast charging tablets or phones simultaneously. TINY CHARGER PACKING A HUGE AMOUNT OF POWERGaN technology enables a tremendous increase in operating efficiency while shrinking the circuit size. Packing a huge amount of power in the smallest charger of its kind on the market today. With the folding prong design, you have a charger that is perfect for both tight spaces and travel.    UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITYFeaturing both USB Type‑A and Type‑C® charging ports, this charger is universally compatible with USB‑powered devices‑like laptops, tablets, and phones‑with over 1,000 products, regardless of manufacturer or brand. FOLDING PRONGSEquipped with folding prongs, this already small charger becomes even smaller, making it extremely travel‑friendly.
